patch_description: This crossover retains the stronger unconstrained RMS-normalized search from the current program, while adding the accept-only active-contact polishing strategy from the higher-quality prior variant. It also replaces repeated full 14-by-14 distance-matrix gradient construction with direct computation over the 91 unique pairs, reducing allocation overhead and allowing the final exact min/max contact refinement to be used efficiently. The construction remains deterministic, returns exactly fourteen finite 3D points, and optimizes the evaluator’s squared distance ratio directly during polishing.
